title: Laureate Education Announces Date of Third Quarter 2025 Earnings Release and Conference Call
summary: MIAMI, Oct. 01, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Laureate Education, Inc. (NASDAQ: LAUR) plans to release results for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, on Thursday, October 30, 2025, before the stock market opens. Following the release, the Company will host a conference call with investors and analysts at 8:30 a.m. ET to discuss the third quarter results and the Company's business outlook. Interested parties are invited to listen to the earnings conference call by registering here to receive dial in information. The webcast of the conference call, including replays, and a copy of the earnings release and the related slides will be made available through the Investor Relations section of the Company's website at www.laureate.net .
